name: RAMPAGE: SAVE LILLY
description: The Warden has taken Lilly to the top of his fortress. Climb the Foundry's girders, run the Machine hall, race the rising Surge up the Ascent, then bring the Warden down by overloading his four couplings. Jump drums for points, grab the Overdrive Gauntlet to smash them. A/D move, W/S climb, Space jump, P pause. Controllers and phones supported.
